name: io.github.crowwdev/crowllm-mcp
description: Search CrowLLM models, read per-million-token prices, and run chat completions with one key.
title: CrowLLM

environmentVariables.name: CROWLLM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: CrowLLM API key, created at https://crowllm.com. Required only for the chat tool; the catalog and pricing tools work without it.

environmentVariables.name: CROWLLM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the gateway base URL. Defaults to https://crowllm.com.
